observations: Three salon trolleys are shown: two black and one pink, arranged side by side.
Each trolley has three tiers with open-front trays and is mounted on four small wheels.
The trolleys appear to be made of metal frames with plastic or coated trays.
The setting is a retail store with shelves stocked with salon supplies in the background.
The pink trolley has a handle at the top, while the black ones do not.
No visible brand or model markings on any of the trolleys.
The wheels appear to be small, possibly plastic or rubber, and are not clearly shown in motion or under load.

claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show trolleys in black and pink, which are visually distinct and commonly considered attractive for salon use.
The wheels are visible in all photos but their material, load capacity, or durability cannot be assessed from still images. No test or movement is shown.

risks.risk: Wheels may not be durable or may not support heavy salon tools and products.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the wheels showing material and construction, or a video of the trolley being loaded and moved.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially weak or unsuitable for heavy use

risks.risk: Trays may be made of thin plastic and could crack or warp under weight.
risks.proof: Close-up of tray material and thickness, or a video showing weight being placed on the trays.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly low-quality or not suitable for heavy-duty salon use

risks.risk: Trolleys may be assembled with weak joints or fasteners, leading to instability.
risks.proof: Close-up of frame joints and connections, or a video showing the trolley being moved or loaded.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or unsafe under use

proof_requests: Close-up of the wheels showing material and construction.
Close-up of the tray material and thickness.
Close-up of the frame joints and connections.
Video of the trolley being loaded with salon tools and moved around.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 3-tier salon trolley, and the seller's claims about color are supported. The claim about 'strong rollers' is unverifiable remotely, but the item can still be priced at its worst case (as potentially weak wheels). Hidden risks related to material quality and durability are noted, but the item is still recognizable and marketable in Abuja as a salon trolley.
